svg.title: The PHP emergency fix by Censys's count of internet-facing services, beside how Python security fixes reached downloads, to 24 October 2026
svg.desc: Two charts. The first is a line chart: the horizontal axis is days since release, 0 to 30; the vertical axis is a share from 0 to 100 per cent, with a dashed line at half. Four blue lines, one per PHP branch, show the share of version-reporting internet-facing PHP services in that branch that Censys counts as patched, by day since PHP's release on 21 October 2026. They start near 2 to 4 per cent on day 0, climb steeply on days 1 and 2 and stop at day 3, the last completed day read: 8.5 73%, 8.4 62%, 8.2 46%, 8.3 46%. An orange band shows the range of four Python security fixes' share of their library's daily downloads, from 54% to 61% on day 1 and 57% to 72% on day 30, nearly flat; a dashed orange line shows the median over 37 Python libraries, 58% on day 1 and 62% on day 30. The two measure different things: services as last scanned, and downloads in a day. The second chart is one bar splitting the 42.6 million PHP services that reported a version on 24 October: 10.1 million patched, 9.0 million in fixed branches not yet counted patched, and 23.5 million on branches PHP did not fix. A further 56.3 million reported no version. Sources: Censys ARC's PHP2Shell dashboard, read by Lighthouse; ClickPy's copy of the Python Package Index download log, read 28 September 2026.
svg.text: PHP's emergency fix, three days in, beside Python fixes' downloads
PHP: share of internet-facing services in each fixed branch that Censys counts as patched.
Python: share of a library's daily downloads at the fixed release or later. Different units; see below.
PHP branch, from 21 October 2026 (Censys); stops at the last completed day read
range of four Python security fixes, 2026 (urllib3, cryptography, pyjwt, starlette)
median over 37 of the most downloaded Python libraries' releases
days since the release (day 0 is the release day, UTC)

svg.text: on a branch with no fix (8.1 and older)
Not yet patched: in a fixed branch, not yet counted patched. Patched shares are floors, not estimates: distributions
that backport the fix keep the old version number, and a rescan must see the change. 56.3 million more reported no version.
Censys ARC PHP2Shell, read 2026-10-25 (LH033); counts services, not machines. ClickPy, read 28 Sept 2026 (LH011).
